findings.title: Fake vault reentrant withdrawal
findings.root_cause: The withdraw function performs an external call before decreasing the caller balance.
findings.impact: A caller can reenter withdraw and repeatedly drain fake vault funds before accounting changes.
findings.proof_sketch: Deposit once, call withdraw, and reenter from the receiver callback before the original balance decrement executes.
reproduction_steps: Deploy the fake vault and deposit funds.
Withdraw through a contract that calls withdraw again from its receive hook.
